# Villa Dew

> Villa Dew is a private four-bedroom pool villa in the Canggu area of Bali, Indonesia (Kerobokan, Kuta Utara, Badung). It sleeps up to eight guests and is booked directly with the owners at https://garda.github.io/villadew/#book.

## Key facts
- Location: Canggu area, Bali — quiet private street, rice-field and mountain views; ~14 km from Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS); Finns Beach Club, Canggu and Seminyak minutes away by car
- Sleeps: up to 8 guests
- Bedrooms: 4 ensuite king bedrooms (3 in the two-storey villa + 1 garden cabin); 4.5 bathrooms; ~280 m²
- Highlights: private pool with hammock, tropical garden, sun terrace, outdoor shower, teak ceilings
- Comforts: air conditioning, fast Wi-Fi, smart TVs with streaming, fully equipped kitchen, free parking, housekeeping
- Check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00; airport pick-up on request
- Booking: live calendar with instant confirmation and secure online payment, best rate when booked direct
- Contact: ask.villadew@gmail.com · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/villadew/
